summary: Verified merchant Accept Order bug fix. All curl checks against devapi.intownlocal.com return the expected schema-valid statuses (404 for ACCEPT/REJECT/PICKUP_READY on non-existent order, 400 for invalid enum PACK/COMPLETED, 404 for /confirmation with no body). Frontend source (utils/api.ts, app/merchant-orders.tsx) uses the new performMerchantOrderAction / confirmMerchantOrderDelivery helpers with correct PUT + {action} body. Built bundle at /app/frontend/dist confirms zero occurrences of the old 'pickup-orders/.../status' pattern and presence of the new pattern with encodeURIComponent(pickupId), performMerchantOrderAction, confirmMerchantOrderDelivery, and /confirmation. /merchant-orders page renders correctly (Customer Orders header, tabs, loading spinner) with no console errors.

issues: Two React #418 (hydration mismatch) errors thrown on initial load — non-blocking but should be investigated. Likely SSR/hydration divergence in the Customer Orders shell.

action_items: Investigate the two React #418 hydration mismatch errors on /merchant-orders (non-blocking, but should be resolved for cleaner SSR).
critical_code_review_comments: utils/api.ts:822 updateMerchantOrderStatus alias correctly routes ACCEPTED/PICKUP_READY/PACKED/REJECTED/COMPLETED — good backward compatibility.
merchant-orders.tsx NEXT_STATUS map is a clean dispatch table with kind: 'action' | 'confirm'.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Bug fix for merchant Accept Order is fully validated at URL/verb/schema level and via built bundle grep. No real merchant order was available to trigger a 200 path; that would require authenticated test credentials + an existing pickup order. Two React #418 hydration warnings on /merchant-orders remain as a minor follow-up.
